cpu: taskset -c 1, one fresh process per sample, alternating variant order per rep

gc-pause.metric: median over reps of the per-process median full (garbage-collect) wall time, nelisp--monotonic-ns
gc-pause.setup: none: no dataset; vector: (make-vector 4194304 7) filled with fixnums and kept live; region: 32 MiB region filled with the same values and kept open

word-access.metric: per-step ns from (t_high - t_low)/(high - low) of a loop doing one write and one read of a word, index (logand i 4095), same interpreter path for both

claims: Report medians and per-rep values. The region GC claim is supported only if region median gc-pause is at least 10% below vector median and within 10% of none. Word access is reported as measured, with no threshold; region ops are generic subr calls (no FXIR inlining, Doc 237 non-goal).
